p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace/programs/task-fd27429a.py')
source='''from collections import Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    # The most common color is the background. Replace it with the marked\n    # color, and replace marked cells with 0.\n    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)\n    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]\n    marked = next(value for value in counts if value != background)\n    return [[marked if value == background else 0 for value in row] for row in grid]\n'''
